name: GitHub - liyucheng09/Selective_Context: Compress your input
snippet: Selective Context compresses your prompt and context to allows LLMs (such as ChatGPT) to process 2x more content. It is especially useful in dealing with long documents and maintaining long conversations without compromising their performance on various tasks!

name: Context Pruning for AI Agents: Methods and Implementation [2026]
snippet: Context pruning in AI agents uses a graduated reduction framework: monitor token utilization at 70/85/95% thresholds, prune stale tool outputs at 85%, apply observation masking to replace older tool outputs with compact placeholders, and use LLM summarization only at 95% overflow.
